name: 57325 · Chamberlain, SD
findings: ZIP 57325 (Chamberlain) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57325 (Chamberlain) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
78% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
